Nepal Floods Cause Devastation, Stranding Foreign Nationals

Catastrophic floods in Nepal have resulted in a rising death toll, with 289 confirmed fatalities and 826 individuals missing, including 517 foreign nationals. China has warned of a potential breach of a newly formed barrier lake within three days, exacerbating flood concerns. India has dispatched two flights carrying 37.5 tonnes of relief supplies and reported that 288 Indian citizens remain uncontactable, while 21 have been rescued. Several Indian states, including West Bengal, have opened helplines for residents missing in the disaster. The floods have also impacted travel agents' businesses and stranded tourists, including 53 Keralites.
